blind.description: A partially decayed animal carcass prop featuring an arched ribcage with a prominent vertebral column along the crest and dark brownish-red rotting flesh or hide draped beneath the ribs. An animal skull with curved horns rests on the ground at one end, and an elongated skull or pelvic bone is attached at the opposite end. Surfaces are solid and sculptural with smooth stylized bone textures and fibrous flesh detailing. It rests directly on the ground on its lower ribs and skull without an artificial base.
blind.from_above: An oval-shaped ribcage arrangement with a central segmented spine running lengthwise over dark brown flesh, flanked by rib arches, terminating in a horned skull on one end and an elongated skull-like structure on the other.
defects: unusual anatomy with skull-like bone structures at both ends of the spine
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 ft tall (roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and approximately 4 to 5 ft long.
